cues.en: Mike: In this video, I'm going to tell you about QQ plots.
cues.zh: 這部影片，介紹QQ圖。

cues.en: It's a bit of a funny name for a plot.
cues.zh: 這圖的名字有點好笑。

cues.en: The Q stands for quintile, and the second Q also stands for quintile.
cues.zh: Q代表分位數，第二個Q也代表分位數。

cues.en: So the full name is quintile-quintile plots.
cues.zh: 全名是分位數對分位數圖。

cues.en: And I'm actually not a huge fan of calling these things QQ Plots, because it's not actually a plot of the Quintiles,
cues.zh: 我其實不太喜歡叫QQ圖，因為不是真的畫分位數，

cues.en: it's a plot of the data against a theoretical distribution.
cues.zh: 而是資料對理論分布的圖。

cues.en: Nonetheless, despite the kind of silly name, QQ plots are actually very informative.
cues.zh: 不過，雖然名字有點傻，QQ圖提供很多資訊。

cues.en: They're used as diagnostic tools to determine whether your data are roughly normally distributed.
cues.zh: 它是診斷工具，判斷資料是否大致常態分布。

cues.en: And that is important because many statistical procedures like ANOVA, T-tests, Regression and so on, assume that your data are more or less normally distributed.
cues.zh: 這很重要，因為ANOVA、t檢定、迴歸等很多統計程序，假設資料大致常態。

cues.en: Okay, so let's begin.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's imagine that I gave you a set of numbers, I gave you a dataset, and I asked you to determine whether that dataset
cues.zh: 想像給你一組數、資料集，請你判斷，

cues.en: was likely collected from a Gaussian process.
cues.zh: 是否可能來自高斯過程。

cues.en: So whether those data came from a Gaussian distribution, how would you go about answering that question?
cues.zh: 是否來自高斯分布，要怎麼回答？

cues.en: Well, one thing you might do is take a histogram of the data and plot a theoretical, or a analytic Gaussian distribution probability density on top.
cues.zh: 一種方式，是畫資料直方圖，再疊上理論、解析的高斯機率密度。

cues.en: And for, you know, this particular dataset, you could get a plot that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 這個特定資料集，可能得到這樣的圖。

cues.en: So here we see the empirical distribution.
cues.zh: 這是經驗分布。

cues.en: This is just the histogram that I am plotting with lines instead of bars and an analytic Gaussian probability density
cues.zh: 只是把直方圖畫成線，取代長條，再加解析高斯機率密度，

cues.en: that was scaled to roughly match the empirical distribution.
cues.zh: 縮放到大致符合經驗分布。

cues.en: So you look at this then you would probably come to the conclusion that these data, the empirical data come from a Gaussian process, come from some kind of phenomenon
cues.zh: 看了可能會下結論，這些經驗資料來自高斯過程，也就是某種，

cues.en: that has a Gaussian distribution that's producing Gaussian distributed data.
cues.zh: 具有高斯分布、產生高斯資料的現象。

cues.en: Okay, so let's try that again with a different dataset.
cues.zh: 換不同資料集再試。

cues.en: And now we see this dataset doesn't really look very Gaussian.
cues.zh: 這個看起來不太高斯。

cues.en: It's not completely non-Gaussian, but it doesn't really look like a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 不是完全非高斯，但真的不像。

cues.en: So first of all, it doesn't have a, you know, it doesn't have any values here that are going down.
cues.zh: 首先，這裡沒有向下延伸的值。

cues.en: Now, maybe that's just a problem with the measurement, or maybe that's something real in the data.
cues.zh: 也許是測量問題，也許是資料的真實情況。

cues.en: That's just the characteristic of the data.
cues.zh: 就是資料特性。

cues.en: And this tail is also much bigger, much longer than we would expect for a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 尾巴也比高斯預期大很多、長很多。

cues.en: So this doesn't really look much like a Gaussian, certainly a lot less compared to this dataset.
cues.zh: 所以不像高斯，比另一個資料集更不像。

cues.en: Okay, so this is a bit qualitative and it's useful, but what we are going to do with a QQ plot is essentially do this comparison, but make it a little bit easier to interpret.
cues.zh: 這有點定性，也有用，但QQ圖基本上做同樣比較，只是更容易解讀。

cues.en: So here you see a QQ plot.
cues.zh: 這裡是QQ圖。

cues.en: This is an example of a QQ plot.
cues.zh: 一個QQ圖例子。

cues.en: And what we have on the Y-axis is our observed distribution.
cues.zh: y軸是觀察到的分布。

cues.en: This is the observed data, and that's coming from these lines here.
cues.zh: 也就是觀察資料，來自這些線。

cues.en: And here this is a theoretical normal probability density.
cues.zh: 這裡是理論常態機率密度。

cues.en: So the Y-axis corresponds to the blue line here and the x-axis corresponds to this green smooth line over here.
cues.zh: y軸對應藍線，x軸對應這裡平滑的綠線。

cues.en: And what you see is that each circle here, each dot corresponds to a data point, so a point in that histogram and the green solid line is the line of unity.
cues.zh: 每個圓、每個點對應一個資料點，也就是直方圖的點，綠色實線則是相等線。

cues.en: So that's just, you know, going from minus four or well, more generally it's going from the lower left to the top right corners of the plot.
cues.zh: 也就是從−4，或者一般地，從圖左下角到右上角。

cues.en: Now here's the idea.
cues.zh: 概念是這樣。

cues.en: If your data are distributed following a normal or Gaussian distribution, then you should see, like this example,
cues.zh: 如果資料服從常態、高斯分布，應該像這個例子，

cues.en: that all of the empirical data points lie more or less on this diagonal line up here.
cues.zh: 所有經驗資料點，大致落在這條對角線上。

cues.en: And there's always gonna be, you know, with empirical data, there's always gonna be some differences here.
cues.zh: 經驗資料總會有些差異。

cues.en: A little bit of wiggles here.
cues.zh: 這裡稍有起伏。

cues.en: It's never gonna be perfectly exactly on this line, but that's fine.
cues.zh: 不會完美落在線上，但沒關係。

cues.en: What we're just interested in is a kind of qualitative judgment about whether the empirical data follow the diagonal.
cues.zh: 只要定性判斷，經驗資料是否大致沿對角線。

cues.en: So you can compare this example with this QQ plot, and this is for the other distribution that I showed in the previous slides.
cues.zh: 比較這個例子與這張QQ圖，後者是前面另一個分布。

cues.en: Lemme go back. So that's this plot here.
cues.zh: 回頭看，就是這張圖。

cues.en: And now we're looking at whether this distribution maps onto the normal distribution.
cues.zh: 現在看它能否映射到常態分布。

cues.en: And you can see here the answer is clearly no.
cues.zh: 答案顯然不行。

cues.en: This empirical distribution does not follow the diagonal here, which means that this is not a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 經驗分布不沿對角線，表示不是常態。

cues.en: Now that doesn't mean there's nothing wrong with it.
cues.zh: 不代表資料有問題。

cues.en: The opposite of normal in this case is not abnormal, but that is important to know for various statistical procedures that we might want to apply.
cues.zh: 這裡常態的相反不是不正常，但對要採用的各種統計程序，這很重要。

cues.en: So what you see is that these data are skewed towards, are away from a theoretical normal distribution.
cues.zh: 資料偏離理論常態分布。

cues.en: So one way you can read this graph is you look here at the value of three, for example.
cues.zh: 一種讀圖方式，例如看數值3。

cues.en: So we would expect for a value of three that the empirical data should be also three.
cues.zh: 預期理論值3，經驗資料也應該是3。

cues.en: But in fact we see that the empirical data are around six and a half or so.
cues.zh: 但實際看到，經驗值大約6.5。

cues.en: So we have much further stretching away from the theoretical normal distribution.
cues.zh: 所以比理論常態延伸得遠很多。

cues.en: And that's the case up here.
cues.zh: 上面如此。

cues.en: And that's the case down here.
cues.zh: 下面也如此。

cues.en: And here it looks like there's actually an inversion where we have the...
cues.zh: 這裡似乎反過來，資料……

cues.en: The data are even less than we would expect given a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 甚至小於常態預期。

cues.en: So there's even a bit less clustering around these values than we would expect for a theoretical normal.
cues.zh: 這些值附近的聚集，比理論常態預期還少。

cues.en: Now that said, you typically don't need to go too deep into the precise interpretations of the different regions of this QQ plot.
cues.zh: 不過，通常不需要深入精確解讀QQ圖每個區域。

cues.en: Mostly we are just interested in determining whether the empirical distribution is roughly following the diagonal, or whether it's not following the diagonal.
cues.zh: 主要只想判斷，經驗分布是否大致沿著對角線。

cues.en: So, evidence for normal distribution, evidence for non-normal distribution.
cues.zh: 也就是常態或非常態的證據。

cues.en: Now why in the world do they call this a QQ plot?
cues.zh: 究竟為什麼叫QQ圖？

cues.en: Because I still haven't shown you any quartiles.
cues.zh: 因為我還沒展示四分位數。

cues.en: Well, the reason is that back in the old days when computer capabilities were much more limited, the way they would generate this line here
cues.zh: 以前電腦能力有限，產生這條線的方法，

cues.en: is by taking the two quartiles, the first and the third quartiles of the theoretical or analytic normal distribution.
cues.zh: 是取理論、解析常態分布的第一與第三四分位數。

cues.en: And that would be the two data points that they would use to draw this line.
cues.zh: 用這兩個資料點畫線。

cues.en: So you evaluate this line at two specific points and the line between them is like this.
cues.zh: 在兩個特定點計算，兩點間的線就像這樣。

cues.en: Now, you know, with modern computers, we don't need to take such barbaric approaches, we can just evaluate this analytic function at any arbitrary resolution that we like.
cues.zh: 現代電腦不需要這種粗略方法，可以用任意解析度計算解析函數。

cues.en: Nonetheless, that's the history of why it's called a QQ plot.
cues.zh: 但這就是QQ圖名稱的歷史。

cues.en: So that's your introduction to QQ plots, quintile-quintile plots.
cues.zh: 以上是QQ圖、分位數對分位數圖的入門。

cues.en: And again, the main idea is that you use QQ plots to determine whether your data distribution is normal.
cues.zh: 主要概念，是用QQ圖判斷資料是否常態，

cues.en: In other words Gaussian, or non-Gaussian.
cues.zh: 也就是高斯，或非高斯。
